title: CE69019: Structural Lab.
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Importance of experimental methods, similitude laws and design of experiments,
some simple measuring instruments, brittle coatings Strain gages - principles
and applications, mechanical, optical and electrical strain gages,
semiconductor strain gages, strain recording instruments. Photoelasticity - Two
dimensional stress analysis, principles and applications. Moire techniques;
Non-destructive testing; Use of Laser for stress measurement. Transducers LVDT, piezoelectric sensors, accelerometers, load cells etc.
